description: Toro and Pancho spend seventeen shorts chasing food, opportunity and one another through increasingly elaborate slapstick, with clever plans normally surviving only until the first impact.

s01e01.description: Toro and Pancho turn “Tall In The Grass” into another escalating chase, with hunger, opportunism and bad planning doing most of the damage.
